description: This file defines a custom live wallpaper service for Android devices, implementing a dynamic animated wallpaper with interactive and visual features such as moving circles, color changes, and background manipulation.

classes.name: SampleWallpaper
classes.description: Main wallpaper service class extending WallpaperService that creates and manages the wallpaper engine.

classes.name: MySampleEngine
classes.description: Inner class extending Engine, responsible for rendering the animated wallpaper with interactive features.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the wallpaper engine.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes display settings, paint objects, and starts the drawing loop.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters display listener to clean up resources.

methods.name: onComputeColors
methods.description: Provides wallpaper colors based on current background color for system accenting.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Starts or stops the drawing loop based on visibility.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input to move the animated circle and change its direction.

methods.name: onSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Stops drawing when the surface is destroyed.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs the drawing of background, text, and animated circle, then schedules the next frame.

methods.name: invertCircleDirectionIfNeeded
methods.description: Reverses the circle's movement direction if it reaches display bounds and generates new color and shift.

methods.name: updateShift
methods.description: Updates the position and radius shift of the circle for animation.

methods.name: genNewShift
methods.description: Randomly generates new movement shift values for the circle.

methods.name: genNewColor
methods.description: Randomly generates a new background and paint color with contrast.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Initializes display information and register display listener.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates display metrics, loads resources, and reset elements based on current display properties.

methods.name: initPaint
methods.description: Initializes the Paint object for drawing.
